$comment: treesync build configurations: debug, asan and release.
Usage: cmake --preset <name>, then cmake --build --preset <name>, then ctest --preset <name>.
Presets format 10 needs CMake 3.31 or later (the version on GitHub's Ubuntu 24.04 runner).
Format 10 is the first one that accepts $comment fields like this one.

configurePresets.name: base
$comment: Shared settings. Hidden: you never use it directly, every other preset inherits from it.
One build folder per preset (build/debug, build/asan, build/release), so configurations never overwrite each other.
compile_commands.json lists the exact compile command for each file: clang-tidy and editors read it.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.$comment: Optimized build without debug symbols. The only one to use for performance measurements (phase 5).

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.$comment: No optimization, with debug symbols (-g). The everyday build, the one to use in a debugger.

configurePresets.name: asan
$comment: Debug + AddressSanitizer (invalid memory accesses) + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (undefined behavior).
Inherits from debug, so it keeps the debug symbols (-g).
-fsanitize=address,undefined is needed twice: when compiling (CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS) and when linking (CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS), because the linker adds the sanitizer runtime library.
-fno-sanitize-recover=all: stop at the first error. By default UBSan prints a message and keeps going, so a test could still pass.
-fno-omit-frame-pointer: keeps the information needed for readable stack traces in sanitizer reports.
Never use this build to measure performance: the sanitizers slow the program down a lot.

testPresets.name: test-base
$comment: Shared test settings, hidden like the configure base preset.
outputOnFailure: show the output of a test only when it fails.
noTestsAction=error: fail when no test is found, so CI can never pass after running zero tests.
stopOnFailure=false: keep running the other tests after a failure, to see every failure at once.
